<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_1841701_github_1.IncidentAgentCockpitAjax</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>true</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>IncidentAgentCockpitAjax</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[// =============================================================================
// IncidentAgentCockpitAjax — server-side endpoint for the Agent Cockpit UI Page.
//
// Companion to IncidentFlightDeckAjax. The Cockpit is a queue-level (multi-
// incident) triage view: it reuses IncidentFlightDeckEngine.getDeck() only on
// demand (when an agent expands a row) and otherwise does fast row-local
// scoring so loading 50 incidents stays under ~1.5s.
//
// Performance trade-off (intentional):
//   loadQueue()  -> _liteScore(gr) per row: priority + SLA snapshot + age +
//                   reassignment / reopen counts + active child count.
//   getFocus()   -> full IncidentFlightDeckEngine.getDeck() for ONE incident.
//
// All write methods (quickUpdate / bulkAck / bulkReassign / bulkTransition)
// require itil and per-record canWrite().
// =============================================================================

var IncidentAgentCockpitAjax = Class.create();
IncidentAgentCockpitAjax.prototype = Object.extendsObject(AbstractAjaxProcessor, {

    MAX_ROWS: 50,
    AT_RISK_BAR: 65,            // lite_scores.escalation >= this -> "at risk"
    STALE_MINUTES: 240,         // 4h since last activity = stale
    AWAITING_STATE: '3',        // "On Hold" treated as awaiting customer/info

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Public AJAX methods
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    loadQueue: function() {
        var scope = this._trim(this.getParameter('sysparm_scope')) || 'mine';
        var sort = this._trim(this.getParameter('sysparm_sort')) || 'urgency';
        var filtersRaw = this.getParameter('sysparm_filters') || '';
        var filters = this._parseFilters(filtersRaw);

        var result = {
            ok: false,
            scope: scope,
            sort: sort,
            rows: [],
            pulse: { total: 0, at_risk: 0, awaiting_customer: 0, sla_breach: 0, stale: 0 },
            user: { name: gs.getUserDisplayName() || '', sys_id: gs.getUserID() || '' },
            shift_started: new GlideDateTime().getDisplayValue(),
            message: ''
        };

        if (!gs.hasRole('itil')) {
            result.message = 'Agent Cockpit requires the itil role.';
            return JSON.stringify(result);
        }

        var gr = new GlideRecord('incident');
        if (!gr.isValid()) {
            result.message = 'incident table not available.';
            return JSON.stringify(result);
        }

        gr.addActiveQuery();
        this._applyScope(gr, scope);
        this._applyFilters(gr, filters);
        this._applyOrder(gr, sort);
        gr.setLimit(this.MAX_ROWS);
        gr.query();

        var rows = [];
        var atRisk = 0;
        var awaiting = 0;
        var slaBreach = 0;
        var stale = 0;
        var lite;
        var row;

        while (gr.next()) {
            lite = this._liteScore(gr);
            row = {
                sys_id: gr.getUniqueValue(),
                number: gr.getValue('number') || '',
                short_description: gr.getValue('short_description') || '',
                priority: gr.getDisplayValue('priority') || '',
                priority_value: gr.getValue('priority') || '',
                state: gr.getDisplayValue('state') || '',
                state_value: gr.getValue('state') || '',
                category: gr.getDisplayValue('category') || '',
                assignment_group: gr.getDisplayValue('assignment_group') || '',
                assigned_to: gr.getDisplayValue('assigned_to') || '',
                caller: gr.getDisplayValue('caller_id') || '',
                opened_at: gr.getDisplayValue('opened_at') || '',
                age_minutes: this._minutesSince(gr.getValue('opened_at')),
                last_activity_minutes: this._minutesSince(gr.getValue('sys_updated_on')),
                sla: lite.sla,
                blocker_count: lite.blocker_count,
                lite_scores: lite.scores,
                next_action_chip: lite.next_action_chip
            };

            rows.push(row);

            if (row.lite_scores.escalation >= this.AT_RISK_BAR)
                atRisk++;

            if (row.state_value === this.AWAITING_STATE)
                awaiting++;

            if (row.sla.status === 'bad')
                slaBreach++;

            if (row.last_activity_minutes >= this.STALE_MINUTES)
                stale++;
        }

        rows = this._postSort(rows, sort);

        result.rows = rows;
        result.pulse.total = rows.length;
        result.pulse.at_risk = atRisk;
        result.pulse.awaiting_customer = awaiting;
        result.pulse.sla_breach = slaBreach;
        result.pulse.stale = stale;
        result.ok = true;

        return JSON.stringify(result);
    },

    getFocus: function() {
        var sysId = this._trim(this.getParameter('sysparm_sys_id'));
        var result = { ok: false, message: '' };

        if (!sysId) {
            result.message = 'sys_id is required.';
            return JSON.stringify(result);
        }

        if (!gs.hasRole('itil')) {
            result.message = 'Agent Cockpit requires the itil role.';
            return JSON.stringify(result);
        }

        var deck = new IncidentFlightDeckEngine().getDeck(sysId);
        if (!deck.ok) {
            result.message = deck.message || 'Could not load incident deck.';
            return JSON.stringify(result);
        }

        var summary = deck.summary || {};
        var fixCards = deck.fix_cards || [];

        result.ok = true;
        result.sys_id = sysId;
        result.number = (deck.incident || {}).number || '';
        result.short_description = (deck.incident || {}).short_description || '';
        result.summary = {
            caller: summary.caller || '',
            assignment_group: summary.assignment_group || '',
            assigned_to: summary.assigned_to || '',
            ci: summary.ci || summary.cmdb_ci || '',
            category: summary.category || '',
            impact: summary.impact || '',
            urgency: summary.urgency || ''
        };
        result.metrics = deck.metrics || {};
        result.next_action = deck.next_action || {};
        result.fix_cards = fixCards.slice(0, 3);
        result.blockers = deck.blockers || { handoff: [], resolve: [] };
        result.sla = deck.sla || {};
        result.last_journal = this._latestJournalEntry(sysId);

        return JSON.stringify(result);
    },

    quickUpdate: function() {
        var sysId = this._trim(this.getParameter('sysparm_sys_id'));
        var note = this.getParameter('sysparm_note') || '';
        return JSON.stringify(this._writeWorkNote(sysId, note));
    },

    bulkAck: function() {
        var sysIds = this._parseSysIds(this.getParameter('sysparm_sys_ids'));
        var note = this.getParameter('sysparm_note') || 'Acknowledged via Agent Cockpit.';
        return JSON.stringify(this._bulkApply(sysIds, function(gr) {
            gr.setValue('work_notes', note);
            return true;
        }));
    },

    bulkReassign: function() {
        var sysIds = this._parseSysIds(this.getParameter('sysparm_sys_ids'));
        var group = this._trim(this.getParameter('sysparm_group'));
        var note = this.getParameter('sysparm_note') || '';

        if (!group)
            return JSON.stringify({ ok: false, message: 'Assignment group is required.', updated: 0, skipped: 0, errors: [] });

        return JSON.stringify(this._bulkApply(sysIds, function(gr) {
            gr.setValue('assignment_group', group);
            gr.setValue('assigned_to', '');
            if (note)
                gr.setValue('work_notes', note);
            return true;
        }));
    },

    bulkTransition: function() {
        var sysIds = this._parseSysIds(this.getParameter('sysparm_sys_ids'));
        var state = this._trim(this.getParameter('sysparm_state'));
        var note = this.getParameter('sysparm_note') || '';
        var allowed = { '2': true, '3': true };  // safe transitions only: In Progress / On Hold

        if (!state || !allowed[state])
            return JSON.stringify({ ok: false, message: 'Only In Progress (2) or On Hold (3) bulk transitions are supported.', updated: 0, skipped: 0, errors: [] });

        return JSON.stringify(this._bulkApply(sysIds, function(gr) {
            gr.setValue('state', state);
            if (note)
                gr.setValue('work_notes', note);
            return true;
        }));
    },

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Private helpers
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    _liteScore: function(gr) {
        var engine = new IncidentFlightDeckEngine();
        var sla = engine._getSlaSnapshot(gr);
        var ageMin = this._minutesSince(gr.getValue('opened_at'));
        var lastMin = this._minutesSince(gr.getValue('sys_updated_on'));
        var priority = parseInt(gr.getValue('priority'), 10) || 4;
        var reopen = parseInt(gr.getValue('reopen_count'), 10) || 0;
        var reassigns = parseInt(gr.getValue('reassignment_count'), 10) || 0;
        var blockers = this._countLiteBlockers(gr);
        var sysId = gr.getUniqueValue();

        // readiness: descriptive context populated and not stale
        var readiness = 100;
        if (!gr.getValue('short_description')) readiness -= 30;
        if (!gr.getValue('cmdb_ci')) readiness -= 15;
        if (!gr.getValue('category')) readiness -= 10;
        if (lastMin > 240) readiness -= 15;
        if (priority <= 2 && !gr.getValue('assigned_to')) readiness -= 25;
        readiness = this._clamp(readiness);

        // reopen risk
        var risk = 10;
        risk += reopen * 25;
        risk += reassigns * 8;
        if (sla.status === 'bad') risk += 25;
        else if (sla.status === 'warn') risk += 10;
        if (lastMin > 480) risk += 15;
        risk = this._clamp(risk);

        // duplicate confidence — lightweight: count active incidents on same CI
        var dup = 0;
        var ciId = gr.getValue('cmdb_ci');
        if (ciId) {
            var dupGr = new GlideRecord('incident');
            dupGr.addQuery('cmdb_ci', ciId);
            dupGr.addQuery('sys_id', '!=', sysId);
            dupGr.addActiveQuery();
            dupGr.setLimit(5);
            dupGr.query();
            var dupCount = 0;
            while (dupGr.next()) dupCount++;
            dup = Math.min(100, dupCount * 25);
        }

        // escalation probability
        var esc = 0;
        esc += (5 - priority) * 18;        // P1 -> +72, P4 -> +18
        if (sla.status === 'bad') esc += 25;
        else if (sla.status === 'warn') esc += 12;
        if (ageMin > 720) esc += 10;
        if (blockers > 0) esc += 8 * blockers;
        esc = this._clamp(esc);

        return {
            sla: { label: sla.label, status: sla.status, detail: sla.detail },
            blocker_count: blockers,
            scores: {
                readiness: readiness,
                risk: risk,
                dup: dup,
                escalation: esc
            },
            next_action_chip: this._chipFor(gr, sla, esc, readiness, blockers)
        };
    },

    _countLiteBlockers: function(gr) {
        var n = 0;
        if (!gr.getValue('short_description')) n++;
        if (!gr.getValue('category')) n++;
        if (!gr.getValue('cmdb_ci')) n++;
        if (!gr.getValue('assigned_to') && parseInt(gr.getValue('priority'), 10) <= 2) n++;
        return n;
    },

    _chipFor: function(gr, sla, esc, readiness, blockers) {
        if (sla.status === 'bad')
            return { label: 'Escalate — SLA breached', tone: 'danger' };
        if (esc >= 80)
            return { label: 'Escalate now', tone: 'danger' };
        if (sla.status === 'warn')
            return { label: 'Triage — SLA at risk', tone: 'warn' };
        if (blockers >= 2)
            return { label: 'Add missing context', tone: 'warn' };
        if (readiness >= 80 && (gr.getValue('state') === '2'))
            return { label: 'Prep handoff', tone: 'info' };
        if (gr.getValue('state') === '1')
            return { label: 'Acknowledge', tone: 'info' };
        return { label: 'Continue work', tone: 'neutral' };
    },

    _applyScope: function(gr, scope) {
        if (scope === 'group') {
            var groups = this._userGroupIds();
            if (groups.length)
                gr.addQuery('assignment_group', 'IN', groups.join(','));
            else
                gr.addQuery('assignment_group', 'NO_RECORDS_SENTINEL');
        } else if (scope === 'watch') {
            gr.addQuery('watch_list', 'LIKE', gs.getUserID());
        } else {
            // mine (default)
            gr.addQuery('assigned_to', gs.getUserID());
        }
    },

    _applyFilters: function(gr, filters) {
        if (filters.priority && filters.priority.length)
            gr.addQuery('priority', 'IN', filters.priority.join(','));

        if (filters.state && filters.state.length)
            gr.addQuery('state', 'IN', filters.state.join(','));

        if (filters.category)
            gr.addQuery('category', filters.category);

        if (filters.has_blockers === true) {
            // narrow to "missing context" candidates without per-row blocker eval
            var qc = gr.addQuery('short_description', '');
            qc.addOrCondition('category', '');
            qc.addOrCondition('cmdb_ci', '');
        }

        if (filters.awaiting === true)
            gr.addQuery('state', this.AWAITING_STATE);
    },

    _applyOrder: function(gr, sort) {
        // Server-side ordering for deterministic paging, then post-sort for
        // composite sort keys (urgency / reopen risk).
        if (sort === 'sla')
            gr.orderBy('sys_updated_on');
        else if (sort === 'last_activity')
            gr.orderByDesc('sys_updated_on');
        else if (sort === 'reopen')
            gr.orderByDesc('reopen_count');
        else
            gr.orderBy('priority');
    },

    _postSort: function(rows, sort) {
        if (sort === 'urgency') {
            rows.sort(function(a, b) {
                if (b.lite_scores.escalation !== a.lite_scores.escalation)
                    return b.lite_scores.escalation - a.lite_scores.escalation;
                return (parseInt(a.priority_value, 10) || 9) - (parseInt(b.priority_value, 10) || 9);
            });
        } else if (sort === 'reopen') {
            rows.sort(function(a, b) {
                return b.lite_scores.risk - a.lite_scores.risk;
            });
        } else if (sort === 'sla') {
            var score = function(r) {
                if (r.sla.status === 'bad') return 0;
                if (r.sla.status === 'warn') return 1;
                if (r.sla.status === 'ok') return 2;
                return 3;
            };
            rows.sort(function(a, b) { return score(a) - score(b); });
        }
        return rows;
    },

    _userGroupIds: function() {
        var ids = [];
        var gr = new GlideRecord('sys_user_grmember');
        gr.addQuery('user', gs.getUserID());
        gr.query();
        while (gr.next())
            ids.push(gr.getValue('group'));
        return ids;
    },

    _parseFilters: function(raw) {
        var out = { priority: [], state: [], category: '', has_blockers: false, awaiting: false };
        if (!raw)
            return out;

        try {
            var parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
            if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object') {
                if (parsed.priority) out.priority = [].concat(parsed.priority);
                if (parsed.state) out.state = [].concat(parsed.state);
                if (parsed.category) out.category = String(parsed.category);
                if (parsed.has_blockers === true) out.has_blockers = true;
                if (parsed.awaiting === true) out.awaiting = true;
            }
        } catch (e) {
            // ignore — return empty filters
        }

        return out;
    },

    _parseSysIds: function(raw) {
        var out = [];
        if (!raw)
            return out;

        var parts = String(raw).split(',');
        var i;
        var v;
        for (i = 0; i < parts.length && out.length < this.MAX_ROWS; i++) {
            v = this._trim(parts[i]);
            if (v && /^[a-f0-9]{32}$/i.test(v))
                out.push(v);
        }
        return out;
    },

    _bulkApply: function(sysIds, mutator) {
        var result = { ok: false, updated: 0, skipped: 0, errors: [], message: '' };

        if (!gs.hasRole('itil')) {
            result.message = 'Agent Cockpit requires the itil role.';
            return result;
        }

        if (!sysIds.length) {
            result.message = 'No incidents selected.';
            return result;
        }

        var i;
        var gr;
        for (i = 0; i < sysIds.length; i++) {
            gr = new GlideRecord('incident');
            if (!gr.get(sysIds[i])) {
                result.skipped++;
                result.errors.push({ sys_id: sysIds[i], reason: 'not found' });
                continue;
            }

            if (!gr.canWrite()) {
                result.skipped++;
                result.errors.push({ sys_id: sysIds[i], reason: 'no write access' });
                continue;
            }

            try {
                if (mutator(gr) !== false) {
                    gr.update();
                    result.updated++;
                }
            } catch (e) {
                result.skipped++;
                result.errors.push({ sys_id: sysIds[i], reason: String(e) });
            }
        }

        result.ok = result.updated > 0;
        result.message = result.updated + ' updated, ' + result.skipped + ' skipped.';
        return result;
    },

    _writeWorkNote: function(sysId, note) {
        var result = { ok: false, message: '' };

        if (!gs.hasRole('itil')) {
            result.message = 'Agent Cockpit requires the itil role.';
            return result;
        }

        if (!sysId || !note) {
            result.message = 'sys_id and note are required.';
            return result;
        }

        var gr = new GlideRecord('incident');
        if (!gr.get(sysId)) {
            result.message = 'Incident not found.';
            return result;
        }

        if (!gr.canWrite()) {
            result.message = 'No write access to this incident.';
            return result;
        }

        gr.setValue('work_notes', note);
        gr.update();

        result.ok = true;
        result.message = 'Work note added.';
        return result;
    },

    _latestJournalEntry: function(sysId) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord('sys_journal_field');
        if (!gr.isValid())
            return { author: '', when: '', text: '' };

        gr.addQuery('element_id', sysId);
        gr.addQuery('element', 'IN', 'work_notes,comments');
        gr.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
        gr.setLimit(1);
        gr.query();

        if (gr.next()) {
            return {
                author: gr.getDisplayValue('sys_created_by') || '',
                when: gr.getDisplayValue('sys_created_on') || '',
                text: (gr.getValue('value') || '').substring(0, 600)
            };
        }

        return { author: '', when: '', text: '' };
    },

    _minutesSince: function(value) {
        if (!value)
            return 0;
        var then = new GlideDateTime(value);
        var now = new GlideDateTime();
        return Math.floor((now.getNumericValue() - then.getNumericValue()) / 60000);
    },

    _clamp: function(n) {
        var v = parseInt(n, 10) || 0;
        if (v < 0) return 0;
        if (v > 100) return 100;
        return v;
    },

    _trim: function(value) {
        return (value || '').replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '');
    },

    type: 'IncidentAgentCockpitAjax'
});]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-04-29 18:15:01</sys_created_on><sys_id>0344632597ec8f50645bb6fce053afb6</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>IncidentAgentCockpitAjax</sys_name><sys_package display_value="GitHub Integration" source="x_1841701_github_1">7437836997e88f50645bb6fce053afb7</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="GitHub Integration">7437836997e88f50645bb6fce053afb7</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_0344632597ec8f50645bb6fce053afb6</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-04-29 18:23:01</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
